scope: Frozen main.ts import-ownership diff against the accepted design, with read-only examination of existing image cleanup, model/history and storage integration.

checks.behavior: updateLoadControls only changes import busy visibility and the dependent replacement button; retireLoad increments ownership and calls that narrow helper. No raw control normalization, rendering, gesture cancellation or history/save mutation occurs in retirement.

Captured input and change retire pending imports before normal field handlers. Raw and changed-back input represent newer intent even without a committed model change; invalid raw number input has no asynchronous retirement-induced normalization.

edit and commit provide command/no-op backstops. Undo/Redo, New concept and sample actions retain existing cancellation; admitted pointer starts retire before creating the new gesture. Import generation changes do not themselves create history entries.

A newer import retires the earlier generation and begins a new busy owner. Existing beginLoad cancellation of an older transient gesture is retained as deliberate import admission behavior; stale completion cannot finish the new busy slot.
adoptLoad checks and consumes current import ownership before shared edit/commit. A valid current complete backup or photo still follows the existing one-edit reversible history/save path.

Complete-backup import checks its token immediately after genuine File.text before parsing/native photo validation, and again after photo validation. Photo import checks after native normalization. Both late rejection and finally paths are generation guarded.

Existing importPhoto closes the acquired ImageBitmap in finally after normalization; validatePhoto likewise closes its acquired bitmap in finally. Retired UI ownership does not bypass those private resource-cleanup paths or publish stale photo data.

pagehide retires import publication authority using the same non-normalizing helper. A delayed result cannot adopt or replace status after this transition. Existing startup generation/startupTouched checks conservatively preserve any saved concept rather than adopting it after intervening intent/lifetime change.

Storage, existing terminal-gated transaction deadlines, record schema, quotas and cross-tab policy are unchanged. Existing committed snapshot autosave remains separate from transient sketch/placement previews.

verificationPerformedByReviewer: Read accepted frozen design and root baseline receipt.
Read frozen main.ts diff and relevant current source handlers.
Read existing native bitmap cleanup paths and ordinary persistence integration.
Pin exact SHA256 of reviewed source and contract.
limitations: This receipt is a source review, not an independent runtime pass. No browser, server, build, test rerun, Git mutation or production edit was performed by this reviewer.
Native eight-case oracle and existing regression gates are owned by other agents/root; their outcomes must be recorded separately.
Controlled pagehide coverage establishes ownership retirement only, not actual BFCache eligibility or physical navigation behavior.
